sentence: Never trust a melancholyamorous heart to a pareson still learning his own door.

wombos.definition: The bittersweet state of being in love with many people while knowing those feelings will go unrequited — a quiet sadness born from loving widely but hopelessly. Can also describe a polyamorous relationship in which all members share a collective sense of melancholy.
wombos.example: She smiled through it, but anyone could tell she was feeling melancholyamorous.

wombos.definition: A parent figure who also carries son energy — someone who is both a guiding presence and a peer.
wombos.example: He's not just a dad, he's a real pareson — always in your corner.
